newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Anaconda up after Glencore placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Anaconda up after Glencore placement.

text.p: The shares of nickel mine developer Anaconda Nickel NL opened much firmer on Monday after the company said it had placed 7.2 million shares with Swiss commodity trading house Glencore International AG
At 11.00 a.m. (2400 GMT), Anaconda shares were 22 cents higher at A$3.70 on turnover of 370,051 shares.
Earlier, Anaconda said the placement at A$3.38 per share would raise A$24.336 million for the development its Murrin Murrin nickel-cobalt project in Western Australia.
"The deal furth3r cements the project'w likelihood of success," a Perth-based dealer said.
The issue increases Glencore'w stake in Anaconda to 19.99 percent from 14.53 percent.
The A$780 million Murrin Murrin nickel project is forecast to produce 100 million pounds of nickel a year once it is fully operational in mid-1998.
Anaconda said in its annual report released last week that it expected to be in a position to select q Murrin Murrin joint venture partner in the current quarter.
